description.en: The Highlands and Islands is an area of Scotland broadly covering the Scottish Highlands, plus Orkney, Shetland, and the Hebrides . The Highlands and Islands are sometimes defined as the area to which the Crofters Holdings Act 1886 applied.
description.zh-CN: 高地和群岛是苏格兰的一个地理和文化分区，通常指苏格兰高地、奥克尼、设得兰以及外赫布里底群岛。
description.zh-TW: 高地和羣島是蘇格蘭的一個地理和文化分區，通常指蘇格蘭高地、奧克尼、設得蘭以及外赫布里底羣島。
